headline: Protect Rezonate; prioritise Ailytics, Fano and Ajentik booths. Use SAP Fioneer and Keysight to test enterprise engineering paths.
positioning: AI/backend engineer who can ship and operate useful systems: Python/FastAPI, data ingestion, AWS deployments, agent retrieval/tools and safe failure handling. Lead with production engineering before awards or broad AI enthusiasm.

basis.availability: Immediate, confirmed 18 October; MTech completion August 2027
basis.judgement: Ranks are editorial judgements about technical fit, vacancy evidence and scarce event time. They are not sponsorship probabilities.

ep.headline: Qualify the role, employing entity and salary band — not the company’s nationality.
ep.note: No priority vacancy checked explicitly confirms Singapore EP sponsorship. Singapore-headquartered product companies can still be worthwhile; an international employer is not automatically willing to sponsor. Public-sector or citizen/PR-only programmes receive less of your limited event time.
ep.question: I’m on a Student Pass and my placement is non-credit-bearing. Can your team host that internship, and for a suitable full-time role do you sponsor EP applications? Who can confirm this for the actual employing entity?
ep.salary: Your saved expectation is SGD 5,000/month, with base versus total unspecified. MOM’s current lowest EP qualifying salary is SGD 5,600 outside financial services; new applications from 1 January 2027 start at SGD 6,000. Thresholds rise with age and differ for financial services. Do not anchor a future EP conversation at SGD 5,000; ask HR for the applicable salary band and eligibility assessment. This does not change your saved expectation.
ep.internship_note: Ask HR to confirm the internship’s applicable work-pass/school route separately. Neither immediate availability nor a future EP discussion establishes internship work permission.

strategies.title: Use a 90-second qualification loop
strategies.text: Give a 20-second technical introduction, ask what an intern would build, then ask about non-credit placement and EP support. If the answer is no sponsorship, mandatory credit or no engineering opening, record it and move on politely.

strategies.title: Show one relevant proof, not a tour of everything
strategies.text: Prepare a 60-second demo or a few local screenshots for ResearchAgent and TalkToIt, and a concise BugRaid deployment story. Use synthetic/demo data. Have the correct company-specific CV ready for the later submission route.

strategies.title: Ask for an owned deliverable
strategies.text: Ask what you could ship in the first four to six weeks, who reviews the code, and how success is evaluated. At Fano and SAP Fioneer, specifically ask how much is implementation versus presales or documentation.

strategies.title: Leave with a named next step
strategies.text: Capture one person/team, an exact role or ITS project, a submission route and a deadline. Ask whether mentioning the booth conversation in your later application is appropriate; do not assume a referral was offered.

strategies.title: Protect the best conversation from queues
strategies.text: Cap speculative booths at about five minutes, save ten to fifteen for core booths, and keep travel buffers. Two targeted talks satisfy the passport without spending the whole morning in sessions. Do not sacrifice Rezonate to collect an extra low-fit sticker.

strategies.title: Follow up while the details are fresh
strategies.text: After the event, check ITS, shortlist the roles whose eligibility is confirmed, and adapt your follow-up to a specific project discussed. The briefing says CV submission and interviews happen afterward.
